dedupe_keys.name: demonstration cases simulation data of energy consumption of residential building typologies

description: Universidad de La Laguna researchers publish energy-retrofit simulation results for five residential building typologies in the ENCORE project. The August 2022 ODS spreadsheet covers Madrid, Berlin and Helsinki as southern, central and northern European climate cases. It reports heating and cooling consumption in kilowatt-hours per square metre per year for insulation, window replacement, combined measures and solar protection scenarios. The file is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its outputs can support comparisons of retrofit assumptions in building-stock simulations or checks of another model’s scenario ordering. The public description leaves the simulation engine, weather years, typology parameters and numerical uncertainty unknown. These are representative scenarios, not measured savings at every building in the three cities. No related catalogue record explicitly includes this spreadsheet. The file and EDEA demonstration inputs were not downloaded.
